set.title: absicht.codec
set.body:
Implementation task. The full self-contained prompt — goal, spec excerpt,
deliverables, out-of-scope, tests, definition of done — lives in `docs/tasks/01-codec.md`.

**Builds:** absicht.codec

**Read first:** `docs/tasks/00-conventions.md` — the layer stack, on-disk
format, id rules, JSON envelope, exit codes and test/commit workflow that
every task assumes rather than repeats.

The single place that knows how an element is spelled on disk. Everything above this layer works with `pydantic` models from `absicht.models`; everything below it (there is nothing below it but `models` itself) never sees a `Path` or a YAML document. This is what CONTEXT.md means by *"Schema in exactly one place"* and what keeps the file format swappable later.

Done means: tests committed first, implementation second,
`./scripts/verify.sh` clean. A new `absicht.*` module must also be added to
`pyproject.toml`'s `[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]` layer list in this task.

Walk a store — a `.absicht/` directory on the working tree, or (later, via `absicht.git`) the same tree at a revision — and turn it into raw per-kind collections of parsed elements, tolerant of individual bad files. This is the layer that makes `ab check`'s schema findings possible: a store with one broken file should report one finding, not crash the whole command.

`./scripts/verify.sh` clean. A new `absicht.*` module must also be added to

set.body:

every task assumes rather than repeats.

**Depends on:** `01-codec.md`

`verification.md` ranks this the single highest-value check in the whole gate — ahead of unit tests: *"Golden tests over fixture systems are the main safety net, not unit tests."* Four small, hand-authored `.absicht/` stores under `tests/fixtures/systems/`, each exercising a different shape of design, that every later task (`load`, `resolve`, `check`, `build`, `packet`, `render`) tests against instead of inventing its own toy data. This task produces the *data*; it doesn't snapshot anything yet (there's nothing to build/render/check until later tasks land) — but structure it so that when those land, `syrupy` snapshot tests slot in against exactly these four without rewriting them.

Done means: tests committed first, implementation second,
`./scripts/verify.sh` clean. A new `absicht.*` module must also be added to
`pyproject.toml`'s `[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]` layer list in this task.

set.title: absicht.check: addendum rules
set.body:
Implementation task. The full self-contained prompt — goal, spec excerpt, deliverables, out-of-scope, tests, definition of done — lives in `docs/tasks/54-check-addendum-rules.md`.

**Builds:** the addendum's check rules across the schema/integrity/policy layers

**Read first:** `docs/tasks/00-conventions.md` and `docs/tasks/50-addendum-conventions.md` — the rule-id table is pinned there; implement it, don't re-derive it. Spec: `docs/spec/ABSICHT-MODEL-ADDENDUM.md`.

**Depends on:** `52-store-wiring.md`, `53-notes.md`

Every Check rule line the addendum states, as ab check findings with registered ids, --explain text, and per rule one fixture that trips it and one that does not: seam-references-resource, observation-at wrong kind, composition and supersession cycles, must_not-has-timing (handled upstream), behavior-needs-observations, requirement-needs-behavior (warn), superseded-in-must-satisfy, note promoted_to resolution.

Done means: tests committed first, implementation second, `./scripts/verify.sh` clean; run `verify.sh mutation` — branchy rule logic is what it exists for.

set.title: Addendum query surface (new/list/show/gaps/trace)
set.body:
Implementation task. The full self-contained prompt — goal, spec excerpt, deliverables, out-of-scope, tests, definition of done — lives in `docs/tasks/55-addendum-query-surface.md`.

**Builds:** `ab new resource|behavior`, list/show/gaps/trace over the new kinds, §7 owner inheritance in queries

**Read first:** `docs/tasks/00-conventions.md` and `docs/tasks/50-addendum-conventions.md`. Spec: `docs/spec/ABSICHT-MODEL-ADDENDUM.md` §0, §7; `docs/spec/cli.md`.

**Depends on:** `52-store-wiring.md`

Resources and behaviors become first-class in the commands that already exist, with --json everywhere — the addendum's rule is that a thing unreachable from the CLI is wrong. Kind enum grows resource and behavior (not note). Behavior template teaches the observation format via the addendum's worked example. Owner inheritance: an unowned unknown reports the owner of its single referencing element — one level, never stored, marked as inherited.

Done means: tests committed first, implementation second, `./scripts/verify.sh` clean, SURFACE entries in tests/test_cli.py updated.

set.title: Derived scope, composition, superseded_by
set.body:
Implementation task. The full self-contained prompt — goal, spec excerpt, deliverables, out-of-scope, tests, definition of done — lives in `docs/tasks/56-derived-scope-composition.md`.

**Builds:** touches/scope_of/composes/composed_by/superseded_by in the resolve layer, surfaced through ab show / ab list

**Read first:** `docs/tasks/00-conventions.md` and `docs/tasks/50-addendum-conventions.md`. Spec: `docs/spec/ABSICHT-MODEL-ADDENDUM.md` §4, §5.

**Depends on:** `52-store-wiring.md`

The three computed facts the addendum insists are never stored: behavior scope (local iff exactly one component and nothing else), the composition graph both ways, and the supersession reverse edge. One home in the resolve layer so list, show, packet and verify read the same answer. State the primitive, compute the structure.

Done means: tests committed first, implementation second, `./scripts/verify.sh` clean, derived tuples deterministic (id-ordered).

set.title: absicht.packet: behaviors — satisfy / must-not-break
set.body:
Implementation task. The full self-contained prompt — goal, spec excerpt, deliverables, out-of-scope, tests, definition of done — lives in `docs/tasks/57-packet-behaviors.md`.

**Builds:** Packet.satisfy / Packet.must_not_break, one-hop composition expansion, rendering

**Read first:** `docs/tasks/00-conventions.md` and `docs/tasks/50-addendum-conventions.md`. Spec: `docs/spec/ABSICHT-MODEL-ADDENDUM.md` §4.2, §5.

**Depends on:** `56-derived-scope-composition.md`, and the pre-addendum packet tasks `31-packet-assembly.md` / `32-packet-cli.md` must land first — this extends absicht.packet, it does not create it.

The addendum's highest-value output: behaviors this slice must satisfy (Milestone.includes filtered to behavior refs) and active behaviors it must not break (touches intersect scope, minus satisfy) — the mechanical form of 'do not regress the rest of the system'. Composition expands exactly one hop; superseded behaviors stop being packet input; notes cannot appear and a test pins it.

Done means: tests committed first, implementation second, `./scripts/verify.sh` clean, same design rev + milestone → byte-identical packet.

set.title: ab verify: observations (checked/no_check/advisory)
set.body:
Implementation task. The full self-contained prompt — goal, spec excerpt, deliverables, out-of-scope, tests, definition of done — lives in `docs/tasks/59-verify-observations.md`.

**Builds:** per-observation verification results in absicht.verify, recorded to the run store

**Read first:** `docs/tasks/00-conventions.md` and `docs/tasks/50-addendum-conventions.md`. Spec: `docs/spec/ABSICHT-MODEL-ADDENDUM.md` §3.1, §9.

**Depends on:** `57-packet-behaviors.md`, `58-run-store.md`, and the pre-addendum verify tasks `40-verify-core.md` / `41-verify-rules.md` must land first.

Does something check every must and must_not observation the packet carried? Three outcomes: checked (with evidence), no_check (unguarded — the distinctive result), advisory (should; reported, never failed, unchecked-should count surfaced). Observations join 40/41's evidence mechanism, anchored by observation id. absicht references evidence, never executes it — the line that keeps this from becoming a BDD tool is drawn here. no_check on satisfy is error; on must-not-break, warn.

Done means: tests committed first, implementation second, `./scripts/verify.sh` clean.

set.title: ab render: behaviors, resources, note inbox
set.body:
Implementation task. The full self-contained prompt — goal, spec excerpt, deliverables, out-of-scope, tests, definition of done — lives in `docs/tasks/60-addendum-render.md`.

**Builds:** site pages for behaviors/resources, traceability integration, diagram nodes for resources, the note inbox page

**Read first:** `docs/tasks/00-conventions.md` and `docs/tasks/50-addendum-conventions.md`. Spec: `docs/spec/ABSICHT-MODEL-ADDENDUM.md` §0, §6.

**Depends on:** `53-notes.md`, `56-derived-scope-composition.md`, and the render tasks `26-render-site.md` / `27-render-diagrams.md` must land first.

Deliberately the last addendum task — the browser is one projection of the model and the least important consumer of it; everything rendered here must already be reachable through the CLI. Behavior pages show trigger, lifecycle, derived scope, the observation table with effective timing, composition both ways. Resources render as boundary nodes. The note inbox surfaces age ('N notes, oldest X months'), and notes stay absent from every graph view.

Done means: tests committed first, implementation second, `./scripts/verify.sh` clean, renders byte-identical twice.
